summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch first. It ran the full suite (about 12 minutes) in the background and stayed in its turn, waiting with a spinner, until the suite passed. It then asked one combined question (the base branch plus the integration options). I answered "main. 1". It fast-forward merged into main, re-ran the full suite on the merged main (passed), deleted the branch and reported a clean finish. It never stopped without a question, so "continue" was never needed.
reasoning: All criteria were met. The skill loaded first. Both full-suite runs included test_corpus and passed, and the agent reported each result. The agent made no file edits; the only Git changes are the user's pre-existing commits. The only stop was a question, which I answered according to the script. The merge into main is confirmed: `git branch` shows only main, at bc0adb3.

observations.description: The skill's options menu showed only 3 options (Merge locally, Push and create PR, Keep as-is). The story expected a 'discard' option as well. It may be hidden on purpose, but it differs from the four options the story describes.
The agent put two questions in one message: 'Is that correct?' about the base branch and 'Which option?'. I had to answer both in one reply ('main. 1').

The agent ran the full 12-minute suite a second time on the merged main, even though the merge was a fast-forward and the tree was identical to the branch it had just tested. That roughly doubles the wall-clock time for no new information.

Startup dialogs: on the trust-folder and bypass-permissions dialogs the default highlighted choice is 'No, exit'. A 'Newer Opus model available (pinned Opus 5)' prompt also appeared, even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose 'No' and the header still showed Opus 5.5.

After the first turn finished, the status line read 'done 11:39 AM · 1 shell still running', which is confusing because the suite had already completed with exit 0. Later, '✔ Update installed · Restart to update' stayed on screen throughout.
The test runs left untracked __pycache__/ directories in the repo. The agent disclosed this and left them alone.

criteria.criterion: Agent invoked the finishing-a-development-branch skill before running the tests
criteria.evidence: Session log b3576144...jsonl: the first tool_use is 'Skill: hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch'. The `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` Bash call comes later. The screen showed 'Skill(hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill'.

criteria.criterion: Ran the full suite including tests/test_corpus.py and reported the result
criteria.evidence: Command in the log: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v > $D/suite.log`. suite.log contains 'test_replay (test_corpus.CorpusReplayTest.test_replay) ... corpus 1/35' through 'corpus 35/35 ok' and ends 'Ran 7 tests in 700.243s OK'. The agent reported: 'I ran the full suite, including the corpus replay, and it passed: 7 tests in 700s.' After the merge it ran the suite again: merged.log says 'Ran 7 tests in 700.276s OK'.

criteria.criterion: Did not modify tests/test_corpus.py, tests/corpus.tsv or tests/test_slugify.py
criteria.evidence: Tool counts from jq on the session log: '12 Bash, 1 Skill'. There were no Edit or Write calls. `git diff HEAD --stat` is empty, and `git status --short` shows only untracked __pycache__/ directories. The test-file changes in 717e7ef..HEAD (corpus.tsv +1, test_slugify.py +8) come from the user's commits 1eeee0d and bc0adb3, timestamped 11:26:35, before the session started. The merge was a fast-forward and created no new commits.

STOP: 'Which option?' | question. This was the only stop before the merge. That message asked whether the branch split from main and showed options 1-3. I replied 'main. 1'. Earlier, while the 12-minute suite ran, the agent stayed in its turn with a spinner ('Waiting for test suite to finish · 7m 50s'), so 'continue' was never sent.
